universe_note:
Chain-level campaign-v1 screen (identity_schema campaign-v1, scenario_id null), first run for this chain. Universe built per LINK across all 11 links, worked in priority order: the money-corner link first, then the CHOKE_POINT link, then the rest by chain position. The mapping (data/mappings/prediction-market-plumbing.json, 18 issuers, 23 placements) carries a fresh-context census audit dated 2026-09-04T22:30:00Z (atlas-fresh-context) that returned status FAIL: not on any evidence defect (52 of 52 sampled placement/listing/search checks came back clean, zero identity/role/source-date conflicts) but because 5 of 11 link_coverage rows are still OPEN under DEPTH-mode design, so method section 6A's COMPLETE gate cannot be met yet. Mapping status stays ACTIVE. Every row this run therefore rests on Ron's 2026-09-01 PLACEMENT-scope rule: audit_scope 'PLACEMENT' declared on the row, admitted only when the consumed placement's role evidence is entirely VERIFIED. 18 of this mapping's 23 placements clear that mechanical bar; the other 5 (funding-and-settlement-rails: PAYPAL, APPLE, BLOCK; liquidity-provision: VIRTU, MAREX) carry only INFERRED role evidence and are refused as screen inputs until the whole-mapping census audit passes or they are re-evidenced VERIFIED. Of the 18 all-VERIFIED placements, only 3 distinct issuers (DRAFTKINGS, BALLYS, CAESARS) have a COMPLETE O1/O2 profile on disk; the other 10 issuers clearing the evidence bar (SPORTRADAR, GENIUS-SPORTS, NASDAQ, ICE, CBOE, RUSH-STREET-INTERACTIVE, KAMBI, CIRCLE, COINBASE, IBKR) are admissible-but-unprofiled this run.

player-eligibility-gate [MONEY CORNER, UNDISCOVERED]: searched and empty. link_coverage status EXHAUSTED, distinct_issuer_count 0. The chain's own bottleneck note already names the private vendors (GeoComply, Xpoint, Jumio, Socure, Persona, Sumsub); this mapping's EXHAUSTED record documents two further opened sources today (the SEC's own EDGAR company registry, and GeoComply's 17 August 2026 FanDuel renewal press page), both NO_QUALIFYING_NAMES, both control-probe-passed (Mitek Systems recovered on the same registry domain as the control), two domains and two source types (OFFICIAL_REGISTRY, PRIMARY_ISSUER) covered. Flutter Entertainment surfaces only as the listed operator parent, not the vendor, and is rejected on that basis. The money-corner link is genuinely empty this run, not merely unscreened.

regulatory-gate [CHOKE_POINT, CROWDED]: searched and empty. link_coverage status EXHAUSTED, distinct_issuer_count 0. The chain scores this link UNINVESTABLE by design: licences are issued by the CFTC, state gaming boards and tribal regulators, none of which is itself an SEC registrant. Two opened sources today (SEC EDGAR company registry search for 'Commodity Futures Trading Commission' and 'Nevada Gaming'; GeoComply's FanDuel renewal page) both NO_QUALIFYING_NAMES, control probe passed. Nasdaq, Inc. is rejected as a listed exchange operator, not a licence-issuing regulator. The CHOKE_POINT link is genuinely empty this run.

official-event-data [OPEN, EMERGING]: searched, admissible-but-unprofiled. Both placements, SPORTRADAR and GENIUS-SPORTS, are ACTIVE with all-VERIFIED role evidence (Sportradar's Kalshi data-and-infrastructure partnership announcement; Genius Sports' FY2025 10-K sports-data-rights disclosure). Neither has a COMPLETE profile on disk; this run screens only, it does not write profiles.

market-surveillance-and-integrity [OPEN, EMERGING]: searched, admissible-but-unprofiled. Both placements, NASDAQ and SPORTRADAR, are ACTIVE with all-VERIFIED role evidence. Neither has a COMPLETE profile on disk.

funding-and-settlement-rails [TARGET_MET, EMERGING]: partially inadmissible, rest admissible-but-unprofiled. 5 placements: CIRCLE and COINBASE clear the all-VERIFIED bar but have no profile on disk. PAYPAL, APPLE and BLOCK carry only INFERRED role evidence under audit_scope PLACEMENT and are refused as screen inputs on an un-audited mapping regardless of profile status; PAYPAL and APPLE are in any case unprofiled, and BLOCK is also unprofiled. No row seated on this link this run.

sportsbook-platform-and-trading [TARGET_MET, UNDISCOVERED]: attributed. This is the link the task names as the chain's live opportunity: 5 ACTIVE placements, all all-VERIFIED role evidence, and the link_coverage row is already closed TARGET_MET. Of the 5 (DRAFTKINGS, RUSH-STREET-INTERACTIVE, KAMBI, BALLYS, CAESARS), 3 have a COMPLETE O2 profile (DRAFTKINGS, BALLYS, CAESARS) and are seated as pure_play rows: each is one of 4 vertically-integrated operators running its own in-house sportsbook platform rather than buying one from Kambi, the link's sole third-party platform vendor. DraftKings' row carries 2 verbatim earnings nuggets verified against its own Q2 2026 8-K (data/edgar/docs/DKNG.json, accession 0001883685-26-000027); Bally's and Caesars carry no nuggets because no EDGAR document for either ticker is on disk this run (2 edgar_doc requests queued below). RUSH-STREET-INTERACTIVE and KAMBI both clear the all-VERIFIED evidence bar but have no profile on disk; admissible-but-unprofiled, next in line for `run profile --campaign`.

prediction-market-venue [OPEN, CROWDED]: attributed plus admissible-but-unprofiled. 3 placements, all ACTIVE with all-VERIFIED role evidence: ICE and CBOE have no profile on disk (admissible-but-unprofiled). DRAFTKINGS is seated a second time on this chain: DraftKings sits on 3 distinct links in this mapping (sportsbook-platform-and-trading, prediction-market-venue, distribution-front-ends), and the screen contract admits a duplicate issuer row when the later row records a non-empty secondary_link_basis (method section 6, check_screen.py check_campaign_identity), which this row does: DraftKings Predictions is a distinct CFTC-lane exchange seat (via the Railbird Exchange acquisition, launched 19 December 2025) from the state-licensed sportsbook business on the first row, with its own earnings-release language and its own CROWDED heat read (Kalshi, Polymarket, ICE, CME and Cboe already occupy this link). One row per issuer per link, not one row per issuer.

clearing-and-collateral [OPEN, EMERGING]: searched, admissible-but-unprofiled. Both placements, CBOE and ICE, are ACTIVE with all-VERIFIED role evidence. Neither has a COMPLETE profile on disk.

liquidity-provision [EXHAUSTED, EMERGING]: partially inadmissible, rest admissible-but-unprofiled. 3 placements: IBKR clears the all-VERIFIED bar but has no profile on disk (admissible-but-unprofiled). VIRTU and MAREX carry only INFERRED role evidence under audit_scope PLACEMENT and are refused as screen inputs on this un-audited mapping. No row seated on this link this run.

distribution-front-ends [OPEN, OVER_CROWDED]: attributed, third DraftKings row. Sole placement DRAFTKINGS is ACTIVE with all-VERIFIED role evidence and is seated a third time under the same secondary_link_basis rule described under prediction-market-venue above: the consumer Super App distributing Sportsbook, iGaming and Predictions to the end user. Bucketed second_order rather than pure_play because the chain's own bottleneck note calls this link 'the crowded end of the map' and 'the demand path, not... the trade' (DKNG and FLUT both repriced the session the Ninth Circuit ruled); the row is written for complete per-link attribution, not because it carries fresh information.

end-user-demand [EXHAUSTED, no verdict]: searched and empty by chain design. The chain's own text: 'The anchor is a household, not a firm, and there is nothing to buy at this position.' link_coverage status EXHAUSTED, distinct_issuer_count 0, consistent with the chain's UNINVESTABLE investability tag on this link.

Net effect: 3 of 11 links produce rows (5 rows total, 3 distinct issuers); the money-corner link and the CHOKE_POINT link are attributed as searched-and-empty with a stated EXHAUSTED record, never silently absent. The single largest concrete next step is `run profile --campaign CAMP-20260901-01` prioritizing sportsbook-platform-and-trading's remaining 2 admissible names (RUSH-STREET-INTERACTIVE, KAMBI) since that link is both TARGET_MET and UNDISCOVERED, then the 8 further admissible-but-unprofiled names on official-event-data, market-surveillance-and-integrity, funding-and-settlement-rails, prediction-market-venue, clearing-and-collateral and liquidity-provision.

Written for completeness of per-link attribution, not as a fresh idea.

revenue_latest_fy.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/DKNG.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
revenue_latest_fy.basis: Revenue for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31, as reported to SEC XBRL companyfacts for CIK 1883685 (DraftKings Inc., Nasdaq: DKNG).

revenue_cagr_3y.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/DKNG.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Three-year compound annual revenue growth computed as (6054525000 / 2240461000) ** (1/3) - 1 from the companyfacts revenue series, fiscal year ended 2022-12-31 to fiscal year ended 2025-12-31.

operating_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/DKNG.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_margin.basis: Operating loss -15817000 divided by revenue 6054525000, both for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31, from companyfacts. Near-breakeven, a sharp improvement from the -608999000 operating loss of fiscal year 2024.

fcf_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/DKNG.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow margin: operating cash flow 662855000 less capital expenditure 15352000, divided by revenue 6054525000, all for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31, from companyfacts.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/DKNG.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Operating cash flow 662855000 divided by net income 3710000, both for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31, from companyfacts. The unusually large ratio reflects a near-zero net-income denominator (DraftKings' first near-breakeven year), not an unusual cash-conversion pattern; operating cash flow itself grew a more ordinary 58.7% year over year (417767000 to 662855000).
